text: The dentist was super nice. A piece of my tooth broke off while I was eating. I went in without an appointment and asked if she could fill it. I was seen right away. She did a great job and was very careful. The price was reasonable too.

Sadly, some dentist's put profit over people.

This dentist supposedly extracted a tooth without the necessary numbing and the patient was crying in pain.

Sometimes dentists need to lose their license 🪪

Avoid The Extra Smile Dental Clinic at all costs.
My friend endured one of the most horrific dental experiences imaginable at this clinic, and I witnessed it firsthand.

While I was waiting in the lobby, I suddenly heard her crying out in pain, repeatedly saying “it hurts too much.” When I rushed in, she was visibly traumatized, trembling and in tears, begging the dentist for more anesthesia. Only after several desperate pleas did the dentist reluctantly administer more novocaine, and even then, it was clearly inadequate.

After nearly two excruciating hours, the dentist had managed to extract only half of the tooth. My friend was in unbearable pain, and the situation had become so intolerable that we had no choice but to leave mid-procedure.

The following day, a reputable dentist took X-rays and was visibly concerned. He confirmed that The Extra Smile should never have attempted the procedure without general anesthesia, something that should have been obvious to any competent practitioner from the start.

We are now paying a significant amount to repair the damage caused by The Extra Smile’s negligence. Although we eventually secured a refund after a heated confrontation with the male dentist, there was no apology, no accountability, and no concern whatsoever for the suffering they caused.

This clinic demonstrated shocking incompetence and a total lack of compassion.

This review will be updated with documentation verifying the incident as my friend's recovery progresses
